question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 to $13.0B +/- $0.3B (Q2 8-K). Over the last six quarters AMD beat its midpoint by +4.8%, +3.9%, +6.3%, +7.0% (partly a one-off MI308 China sale), +4.6% and +3.0% (Q2 2026: $11.54B vs $11.2B). Applying a slightly smaller beat of about 3.5-4% gives a median near $13.5B. Pushing up: Stifel expects an EPYC-driven beat-and-raise, and AMD raised its H2 server growth outlook to >80% YoY. Pushing down: memory price inflation may hurt PC chips, MI450 revenue mostly starts in Q4, and the beats have been shrinking. Market check: none found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi. Consensus is about $13.06B.
calls.dossier:
- AMD Q2 2026 8-K (Aug 4 2026): Q3 2026 revenue guide about $13.0B +/- $0.3B ($12.7-13.3B), +41% YoY and +13% QoQ; non-GAAP GM about 56%.
- Q2 2026 actual $11.536B vs guide $11.2B +/- $0.3B (+3.0% vs midpoint); Data Center $6.72B, +107% YoY (CNBC / AOL, Aug-Oct 2026).
- Q1 2026 actual $10.253B vs guide about $9.8B (+4.6%); Q4 2025 $10.27B vs $9.6B (+7%, included about $390M one-off MI308 China sales); Q3 2025 $9.246B vs $8.7B (+6.3%); Q2 2025 $7.685B vs $7.4B (+3.9%); Q1 2025 $7.438B vs $7.1B (+4.8%). Base rate: 6 of 6 recent quarters beat the midpoint, by 3-7%.
- Consensus (MarketBeat, Oct 2026): about $13.06B revenue, EPS $1.94; some sources list older consensus of $12.4-12.5B.
- Stifel (Oct 2026, via Benzinga/TradingView): expects a Q3 beat-and-raise driven by EPYC; AMD raised its H2 2026 server revenue growth outlook to >80% YoY.
- MI450 revenue begins in Q4 2026; first Anthropic gigawatt is in H1 2027, so little MI450 contribution in Q3.
- Downside factors: memory price inflation hitting the client PC business; the stock fell about 19% from its Oct 6 peak ($649) to about $530 (no company-specific revenue warning found).
- Report date: Nov 3 2026, after the close. Resolves off the revenue line in AMD's Q3 2026 earnings release / 8-K, not consensus or later revisions.
- Event window: quarter Jul-Sep 2026, already closed; report due Nov 3 2026, 13 days after Now (Oct 21 2026).
- Searched but not found: any preannouncement or guidance change after Aug 4; a prediction market on AMD Q3 revenue (none on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi).

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 to $13.0B +/- $0.3B. Across the last 8 quarters it beat the midpoint every time, by +1.8% to +7.0% (mean ~4.2%; Q4'25 boosted by one-off China MI308 sales). calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the guide ($13.0B +/- 0.3B), the Q2 beat (+3.0%), the Nov 3 report date and that no market exists. Factual dispute: whether to include Q3'24/Q4'24 beats (+1.8%/+2.1%, only in Run 3). No search was possible; those figures match my own memory (guides 6.7/7.5 vs actuals 6.82/7.66), so I included them, which widens the low tail. Judgment dispute: Run 2 centred on the larger 2025 beats (median 13.61B). I discounted Q4'25's one-off China sales and the declining recent trend and centred at a ~4% beat (13.52B). I carried forward Run 3's dispersion (~0.64B), which is consistent with the computed beat SD.

~2%: would need a >9% beat, which has not happened in the class
